mapper.insert: insert into biz_funnel_daily (stat_date, funnel_code, step_code, source, city_code, user_count, event_count, conversion_rate, create_time, update_time) with normalized as ( select date(event.occurred_at) as stat_date, case when event.event_name in ('community_post_impression', 'community_post_open', 'community_post_qualified_view') or (event.biz_type = 'community_post' and event.event_name in ('content_like', 'content_favorite', 'content_share')) then 'community_post_engagement' when event.event_name in ('content_view', 'content_like', 'content_favorite', 'content_share') then 'content_engagement' when event.event_name in ('signup_start', 'signup_submit', 'payment_success') then 'activity_conversion' when event.event_name in ('template_reuse', 'topic_publish_success', 'activity_publish_success') then 'creator_conversion' else 'general' end as funnel_code, event.event_name as step_code, event.biz_type as source, event.city_code, event.member_id, event.occurred_at, case when event.event_name in ('community_post_impression','content_view','signup_start','template_reuse') then 1 else 0 end as is_funnel_start from biz_event_log event left join community_post cp on event.biz_type = 'community_post' and cp.id = event.biz_id where event.occurred_at >= cast(#{statDate} as date) and event.occurred_at <= timestamp(cast(#{statDate} as date), '23:59:59') and (event.event_name <> 'community_post_qualified_view' or (event.member_id is not null and cp.id is not null and cp.author_id <> event.member_id)) ), funnel_starts as ( select stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code, member_id, min(occurred_at) as first_started_at from normalized where is_funnel_start = 1 and member_id is not null group by stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code, member_id ), aggregated as ( select event.stat_date, event.funnel_code, event.step_code, event.source, event.city_code, count(distinct event.member_id) as user_count, count(distinct case when event.is_funnel_start = 1 or starter.member_id is not null then event.member_id end) as attributed_user_count, count(1) as event_count, event.is_funnel_start from normalized event left join funnel_starts starter on starter.stat_date = event.stat_date and starter.funnel_code = event.funnel_code and starter.source <=> event.source and starter.city_code <=> event.city_code and starter.member_id = event.member_id and starter.first_started_at <= event.occurred_at group by event.stat_date, event.funnel_code, event.step_code, event.source, event.city_code, event.is_funnel_start ), scored as ( select aggregated.*, max(case when is_funnel_start = 1 then attributed_user_count end) over (partition by stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code) as start_user_count from aggregated ) select stat_date, funnel_code, step_code, source, city_code, user_count, event_count, case when start_user_count > 0 then round(attributed_user_count / start_user_count, 4) else 0 end as conversion_rate, now() as create_time, now() as update_time from scored
mapper.select: with qualified_user_posts as ( select event.member_id, event.biz_id, post.author_id as current_author_id, min(event.occurred_at) as first_qualified_at, max(event.occurred_at) as last_qualified_at from biz_event_log event left join community_post post on post.id = event.biz_id where event.event_name = 'community_post_qualified_view' and event.biz_type = 'community_post' and event.member_id is not null and event.occurred_at >= cast(#{startDate} as date) and event.occurred_at <= timestamp(cast(#{endDate} as date), '23:59:59') group by event.member_id, event.biz_id, post.author_id ) select count(distinct member_id) as qualified_user_count, count(1) as qualified_user_post_count, count(distinct biz_id) as qualified_post_count, count(distinct nullif(current_author_id, 0)) as current_qualified_author_count, min(first_qualified_at) as first_qualified_at, max(last_qualified_at) as last_qualified_at from qualified_user_posts
mapper.sql: r.owner_type = 1 and (r.purchase_kind = 2 or (r.purchase_kind is null and r.ticket_id is null and r.expires_at is not null))
mapper.select: select fact.stat_date as stat_date, fact.topic_id as topic_id, topic.name as topic_name, fact.step_code as step_code, count(distinct fact.member_id) as member_count, count(distinct fact.fact_key) as fact_count from ( select date(e.occurred_at) as stat_date, e.biz_id as topic_id, 'detail_view' as step_code, e.member_id as member_id, concat('event:', e.id) as fact_key from biz_event_log e where e.event_name = 'content_view' and e.biz_type = 'topic' and e.biz_id > 0 and e.occurred_at >= cast(#{from} as date) and e.occurred_at < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(e.occurred_at), e.biz_id, 'checkout_open', e.member_id, concat('event:', e.id) from biz_event_log e where e.event_name = 'checkout_open' and e.biz_type = 'topic' and e.biz_id > 0 and e.occurred_at >= cast(#{from} as date) and e.occurred_at < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(r.create_time), r.owner_id, 'order_created', r.member_id, coalesce(nullif(r.parent_order_no, ''), concat('registration:', r.id)) from cms_registration r where and r.create_time >= cast(#{from} as date) and r.create_time < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(r.payment_time), r.owner_id, 'paid', r.member_id, coalesce(nullif(r.parent_order_no, ''), concat('registration:', r.id)) from cms_registration r where and r.payment_status in (2, 4) and r.payment_time >= cast(#{from} as date) and r.payment_time < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(r.payment_time), r.owner_id, 'paid_cash', r.member_id, coalesce(nullif(r.parent_order_no, ''), concat('registration:', r.id)) from cms_registration r where and r.payment_status in (2, 4) and coalesce(r.payable_amount, r.total_amount, 0) > 0 and r.payment_time >= cast(#{from} as date) and r.payment_time < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(s.create_time), s.topic_id, 'play_started', s.member_id, concat('session:', s.id) from topic_route_session s where s.activity_id = 0 and s.create_time >= cast(#{from} as date) and s.create_time < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(s.completed_at), s.topic_id, 'completed', s.member_id, concat('session:', s.id) from topic_route_session s where s.activity_id = 0 and s.completed_at >= cast(#{from} as date) and s.completed_at < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) union all select date(coalesce(f.reviewed_at, f.create_time)), r.owner_id, 'refunded', r.member_id, concat('refund:', f.id) from refund_application f join cms_registration r on r.id = f.source_id where f.source_type = 'registration' and f.del_flag = 0 and f.status = 1 and and coalesce(f.reviewed_at, f.create_time) >= cast(#{from} as date) and coalesce(f.reviewed_at, f.create_time) < cast(#{toExclusive} as date) ) fact left join cms_topic topic on topic.id = fact.topic_id group by fact.stat_date, fact.topic_id, topic.name, fact.step_code order by fact.stat_date desc, fact.topic_id asc, fact.step_code asc

select
e.stat_day, null as stat_day,
sum(e.started) as runs_started, sum(e.completed) as runs_completed, sum(case when e.duration_seconds is not null then 1 else 0 end) as duration_runs, sum(e.duration_seconds) as duration_seconds_sum, count(distinct e.member_id) as players from ( select date_format(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, s.member_id, 1 as started, 0 as completed, null as duration_seconds from topic_route_session s where s.topic_id = #{topicId} and s.create_time >= #{from} and s.create_time < #{to} union all select date_format(s.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, s.member_id, 0 as started, 1 as completed, case when s.completed_at >= s.create_time then timestampdiff(second, s.create_time, s.completed_at) end as duration_seconds from topic_route_session s where s.topic_id = #{topicId} and s.completed_at >= #{from} and s.completed_at < #{to} ) e
group by e.stat_day order by e.stat_day

select date_format(f.reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, count(1) as refunds from refund_application f where f.del_flag = 0 and f.status = 1 and f.source_type = 'registration' and ((f.owner_type = 1 and f.owner_id = #{topicId}) or (f.owner_type = 2 and f.owner_id in (select a.id from cms_activity a where a.topic_id = #{topicId}))) and f.reviewed_at >= #{from} and f.reviewed_at < #{to} group by date_format(f.reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_day

select n.id as node_id, n.name as station_name, n.sort_id, case when n.merchant_member_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as has_merchant from cms_topic_node n where n.topic_id = #{topicId} order by n.sort_id, n.id

select
e.stat_day, null as stat_day,
e.node_id, sum(e.arrived) as arrivals, sum(e.completed) as completions, sum(e.verified) as verifications, sum(e.perk) as perk_redemptions, count(distinct e.member_id) as players from ( select date_format(coalesce(p.visit_time, p.create_time, p.checkin_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, p.node_id, p.member_id, 1 as arrived, 0 as completed, 0 as verified, 0 as perk from player_node_progress p where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.del_flag = 0 and coalesce(p.visit_time, p.create_time, p.checkin_time) >= #{from} and coalesce(p.visit_time, p.create_time, p.checkin_time) < #{to} union all select date_format(p.checkin_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, p.node_id, p.member_id, 0 as arrived, 1 as completed, 0 as verified, 0 as perk from player_node_progress p where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.del_flag = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.checkin_time >= #{from} and p.checkin_time < #{to} union all select date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_day, sn.node_id, g.member_id, 0 as arrived, 0 as completed, 1 as verified, case when o.terms_mode = 'PERK' then 1 else 0 end as perk from ( select n.chapter_id, n.merchant_member_id, min(n.id) as node_id from cms_topic_node n where n.topic_id = #{topicId} and n.merchant_member_id is not null and n.chapter_id > 0 group by n.chapter_id, n.merchant_member_id ) sn join redemption r on r.chapter_id = sn.chapter_id and r.merchant_id = sn.merchant_member_id left join merchant_chapter_offer o on o.id = r.offer_id left join cms_registration g on g.id = r.registration_id where r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.create_time >= #{from} and r.create_time < #{to} ) e group by e.stat_day, e.node_id order by e.stat_day, e.node_id

select p.node_id, count(1) as completions, count(distinct p.member_id) as players from player_node_progress p where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.del_flag = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.checkin_time is null group by p.node_id
